def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); hr=next(r for r in range(h) if all(v==3 for v in grid[r])); vc=next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==3 for r in range(h)))
    # For each side of the cross, fill the repeating alternating stripe/fractal motif.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if r==hr or c==vc: continue
        # seed horizontal and vertical stripes at the outermost edge of each quadrant
        rr=r if r<hr else r-hr-1
        cc=c if c<vc else c-vc-1
        # nested pattern: recursive squares create a 4 on odd/even coordinate residues
        val = (cc%2==0)
        # turn on/off expanding rectangular runs at powers of two
        for k in range(1, max(h,w)):
          if rr==2**k-1:
            val = cc < 2**(k+1)
        out[r][c]=4 if val else 0
    return out
PY
